mapper.sql: id, idx, seg_key, label, icon, type, description, percent, points, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM game_segments ORDER BY idx ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM game_segments WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY idx ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM game_segments WHERE seg_key = #{segKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_segments (idx, seg_key, label, icon, type, description, percent, points, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{idx}, #{segKey}, #{label}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{description}, #{percent}, #{points}, #{enabled}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE game_segments SET idx = #{idx}, label = #{label}, icon = #{icon}, type = #{type}, description = #{description}, percent = #{percent}, points = #{points}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE game_segments SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
